repeatAnalysis.note: Three attempts on ten selected difficult source cases per model, not thirty independent cases. Automated scores measure observed generator-plus-judge consistency; grader variability remains a limitation. No release outputs or thresholds are changed.

costs.note: Phase charges and cumulative ledger charges are separate. Reservations are not counted as spend; known subtotals exclude unknown settlements, and totals remain null when any settlement is unknown.

interpretation.sampleUnit: Ten unique source cases per generator; three attempts per case/configuration (30 attempts/configuration, 60 total). Repeated attempts do not add independent source cases.
interpretation.scoreAttribution: Observed consistency combines generator sampling and Argon grader behavior. Scores are automated and are not human ground truth.
interpretation.variability: Score disagreements on byte-identical outputs are direct evidence of grader-label variability for those pairs; absence in this small sample does not prove grader stability.
interpretation.failures: All attempts, including failed, incomplete, unresolved, and reused observations, remain represented in the sanitized JSONL.
interpretation.providerSanitization: Provider names may be present; provider generation/request identifiers are omitted using the local export-phase projection.
interpretation.review: Reviewed against retained raw records before publication.

reusedPrimaryJudgeComparison.note: These are fresh Argon judgments of exactly reused generation text. Score changes are grader variability, not changed generator output. Original judgments remain unchanged.

rawFileDigests.note: Digests identify retained private raw bytes at phase end; public observations omit private provider IDs.
